title: Anti-freeze gating — prevent UI thread blocking under pressure
description: Heavy deferred work (evolution snapshot, dev packet, autonomy dock) is gated under HIGH/CRITICAL resource pressure so the UI thread stays responsive.
resume_hint: Budget accounting for total UI-thread time per frame not yet implemented. BackgroundResourceMonitor integration pending.
next_action: Implement per-frame budget accounting and integrate BackgroundResourceMonitor if available.

metadata.coverage_detail: _should_defer_heavy_work() gate using _assess_resource_pressure(). Fixed IssueSeverity comparison bug (str(IssueSeverity.HIGH) returns 'IssueSeverity.HIGH' not 'high'). Gate applied in both _apply_task_result and _apply_task_failure.
metadata.p01_additions: Stub tests for _should_defer_heavy_work extracted to lightweight suite (no AppBootstrap).
remaining: Budget accounting for total UI-thread time per frame
metadata.unresolved: User-visible UI proof pending — requires live testing on user's Windows machine
